# Coastline Digital
> Coastline Digital is a US-based software engineering and AI consulting company. We help companies design, build, and scale software products, AI solutions, and enterprise systems with experienced engineering teams.

Senior engineering expertise. Practical AI. Software built for business.

## Services
- Custom Software Engineering: Web applications, SaaS platforms, and backend systems engineered for reliability and long-term maintainability. https://coastlinedigital.net/services/custom-software-development/
- AI and Machine Learning: Generative AI applications, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, and predictive models, scoped to a real business problem and tested before launch. https://coastlinedigital.net/services/ai-machine-learning/
- Cloud and Data Engineering: Cloud architecture, infrastructure, delivery pipelines, data platforms, and integrations that keep systems connected and dependable. https://coastlinedigital.net/services/cloud-data-engineering/
- Enterprise Applications and Modernization: Modernize legacy applications, connect enterprise systems, and automate operations without disrupting the business. https://coastlinedigital.net/services/enterprise-applications/
- Dedicated Engineering Teams: Experienced engineers who join your roadmap, tools, and delivery rhythm, with Coastline Digital accountable for quality and continuity. https://coastlinedigital.net/services/dedicated-engineering-teams/

## Engagement models
- Dedicated Engineering Team: Flexible, long-term technical capacity. Product companies with an ongoing roadmap that need more capacity or specific skills.
- Project-Based Delivery: Defined deliverables, milestones, and timelines. Companies with a defined product, feature set, integration, or modernization goal.
- Engineering Delivery Partnership: Subcontracting and white-label support for consulting and technology firms. Agencies, consultancies, and technology firms delivering software for their own clients.
- Engineering partnerships for agencies and consulting firms: https://coastlinedigital.net/partnerships/

## How we work
- Discover: Understand business needs and technical requirements.
- Architect: Design a scalable, practical solution.
- Build: Deliver through clear engineering milestones.
- Validate: Test quality, reliability, and performance.
- Launch and Improve: Deploy and support ongoing improvements.
